alert_lead: No new strong deals today. The private South Gate 2020 CX-5 Grand Touring ($13,500, STRONG) is gone. The Mesquite Kona ($16,000) and Riverside RAV4 XLE Premium ($19,000) private STRONGs are still live. New local private Teslas showed up (2019 Model 3 SR+ 97.5k at $15,300, and 2021 SR+ 59k at $20,500), both FAIR. The Globul LV Mach-E went up to $21,999, which is now over the cap.

criteria.geo: LV metro first; tier 2 only if exceptional

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: Private 2020 Kona 1.6 Turbo with only 26k mi at $16,000, clean title (CL attribute), Southern NV (~72 mi).
best_current_candidates.concerns: Exact trim UNKNOWN (the 1.6T came on Limited/Ultimate/Night), FWD per CL attribute. The ad mentions a scratch on the front passenger door. Sparse ad with no VIN or service history; check the VIN, title and Carfax before driving out.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: Private 2022 RAV4 XLE Premium FWD, 51.4k mi, $19,000. Ad says one owner, clean CA title, always in California, Toyota dealer service records up to date, and no warning lights. A pre-purchase inspection by your mechanic is allowed. That is roughly $5k+ under typical retail for this year/trim/miles (estimate).
best_current_candidates.concerns: Tier 2 (~201 mi). No VIN in the ad, so run Carfax/title once you have it. Priced well below market, so confirm the title is in the seller's name and meet in person (ad: cash or cashier's check in person, test drive by appointment). Normal steering-wheel/interior wear disclosed. FWD.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: Cheapest local Bolt Premier under 70k mi; $14,699 fees-in vs local Bolt asks $16,155 (2020 LT 53.6k mi) to $17,399 (2021 Premier 66.6k mi); CarGurus "Great Deal". Premier trim = leather, DC fast charge, better equipped than LT.
best_current_candidates.concerns: Dealer; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; 69k mi (upper end of EV preference); verify GM battery-recall replacement status (2020 Bolt) and price on dealer site (CarGurus card only).

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2022 Kia Niro EV (64 kWh pack, 239 mi EPA when new) with 66.9k mi at $14,799 fees-in, LV dealer 7 mi. That is about $4.2k under the other two local Niro EV dealer asks (2023 Wind 52.8k $18,990; 2022 30.8k $19,999) and priced like the 2020 Bolt Premier STRONG while being two model years newer.
best_current_candidates.concerns: 66.9k mi — at the top of the EV mileage guideline; trim not shown on card (VIN suggests a 2022 Niro EV, confirm EX vs EX Premium); battery state of health UNKNOWN (ask for a battery report); no CarGurus deal badge shown; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; dealer.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2021 Hyundai Kona Electric Limited (top trim, 64 kWh, 258 mi EPA when new) with only 32.1k mi, cut $4,000 to $15,990 fees-in at a Henderson dealer (18 mi). The tracked 2023 Kona Electric SEL 34.5k is $19,045 locally, so this is ~$3k cheaper for the top trim with similar miles.
best_current_candidates.concerns: Confirm the Hyundai Kona Electric high-voltage battery recall/campaign status for this VIN (earlier Kona Electric model years had a battery-replacement recall); battery state of health UNKNOWN; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; dealer.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: Last-year Bolt, CarGurus "Good Deal", fees included; 2023 Bolt EV median $20,798.
best_current_candidates.concerns: Confirm Carfax; DC fast charging is slow (~55 kW).

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2023 Kia Niro EV Wind (2nd-gen, 64.8 kWh) 52.8k mi cut another $2,000 to $16,990 at a Henderson dealer (18 mi). That is ~$3.8k under the other tracked local 2023 Niro EV ($20,799) and close to the tier-2 private Chino 2023 Wind ($16,000, 58.7k) while being local.
best_current_candidates.concerns: 52.8k mi; card no longer shows a "Price includes fees" tag or deal badge — confirm out-the-door price; battery state of health UNKNOWN; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; dealer.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 3-row 2019 Highlander XLE AWD under $17k; 2019 Highlander national median $24,487.
best_current_candidates.concerns: Price this far under market at a subprime-financing lot: insist on Carfax (accident/rental/fleet), cash OTD in writing, and an independent pre-purchase inspection.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2020 Mazda CX-9 Sport (3-row SUV) with 70k mi in Henderson at $17,696 fees-in, rated a CarGurus "Great Deal" — newer than most in-budget CX-9s, under the 80–100k mile target.
best_current_candidates.concerns: Base Sport FWD trim; CarGurus rating is the only comp evidence (no Blue Book check yet); dealer; title/Carfax UNKNOWN — verify accident history and price on the dealer VDP.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: CarGurus "Great Deal", fees included; 2021 CX-5 median $22,314.
best_current_candidates.concerns: VIN not in CarGurus card — get VIN + Carfax; 70.7k mi.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2021 CX-5 Signature AWD (top trim, 2.5L turbo 250 hp per card) at $19,497 fees-in, LV dealer 7 mi, CarGurus "Great Deal". Newer/better-equipped than the tracked STRONG 2021 CX-5 Touring AWD (70.7k mi, $18,794, unseen since 10-09).
best_current_candidates.concerns: 82.8k mi (within ~80-100k ICE guideline but upper half); CarGurus market value not shown in fetch so savings UNKNOWN; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; dealer.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2021 CX-30 Preferred AWD with 32.2k mi at $19,299 (cut $500 from $19,799), Henderson 18 mi. It is the lowest-mile AWD CX-30 being tracked. It is cheaper and 17k mi lower than the tracked 2021 CX-30 AWD certified 49.8k at $19,694, and it replaces the stale STRONG CX-30 Premium 44k $19,978.
best_current_candidates.concerns: Subcompact crossover (small rear seat and cargo). No CarGurus deal badge shown on the card. Dealer fees/OTD UNKNOWN; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; dealer.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 SE RWD with 53.6k mi cut $2,048 to $18,990 at a Henderson dealer (18 mi). The tracked local 2022 IONIQ 5 is $20,880, so this is a newer car for ~$1.9k less; 800V fast charging.
best_current_candidates.concerns: 53.6k mi; confirm it is the long-range SE (77.4 kWh) and not SE Standard Range by VIN/window sticker; no "Price includes fees" tag on the card — confirm out-the-door; battery health UNKNOWN; title/Carfax UNKNOWN; dealer.

best_current_candidates.why_interesting: CarGurus "Great Deal", fees included; 2022 Corolla Cross median $23,995.
best_current_candidates.concerns: 75.6k mi; $990 under the $21k ceiling — tax/title will push OTD near/over $21k.

notable_fair_locals.why_interesting: Local private-party Tesla: 2019 Model 3 SR+ 97.5k at $15,300, ~$3k under LV dealer 2019 Model 3s at 83-92k mi ($18.6k-$20k).
notable_fair_locals.concerns: 97.5k mi is past the EV mileage target; the 8-yr/100k battery warranty is nearly used up on miles. Title, VIN and battery health UNKNOWN. Listing URL not captured (seen on the Cars.com LV EV SRP as "Private seller: Peter" and on AutoTrader Private Seller Exchange).

notable_fair_locals.why_interesting: Local private 2021 Model 3 SR+ with ~59k mi; LV dealer 2021 SR+ comps are $18,998-$20,998 at 94k-118k mi, so this is the lowest-mile one near budget.
notable_fair_locals.concerns: At the $21k ceiling; mileage rounded (59K) on the card; VIN/title UNKNOWN; URL not captured.

notable_fair_locals.why_interesting: 2025 Leaf S 14k mi; now $16,697 after a +$1,998 increase, above certified Planet Nissan 2025 Leaf S comps.
notable_fair_locals.concerns: Short range (~149 mi EPA), CHAdeMO fast-charge standard is fading; verify Carfax (likely ex-rental).

notable_fair_locals.why_interesting: 38k-mi 2021 ID.4 Pro at $18.3k fees-in; larger battery than the Standard-trim 2024.
notable_fair_locals.concerns: ID.4 software/recall history to check; 2024 ID.4 Standard (18k mi) is only ~$700 more.
